newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Danubius hits new high on Budapest.
newsitem.headline: Danubius hits new high on Budapest.

text.p: Hungarian share prices were mostly steady or little changed on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Thursday, although gains by some heavy-weight papers pushed the index higher, traders said.
The BUX index ended at 3,471.25 points, up 31.56, thanks primarily to gains of hotelier Danubius and oil company MOL.

Spot share turnover was a maigre 493.8 million forints, reflecting that major investors still remained on the sidelines, leaving the market's short-term outlook trendless, partly because due to uncertainty over Russian president Yeltsin's health, Tamas Revesz of Gog Securities said.

Having opened practically unchanged from Wednesday Danubius began to soar after Hungary's privatisation agency APV Rt announced that it and Danubius will sign the agreement over the purchase (by Danubius) of an 85 percent stake in hotel chain Hungaria Szalloda Rt tomorrow.
Danubius rose to a new record of 3,105 forints, but it retreated to end at 3,100, up 100.
Oil company MOL was a strong gainer as it put on 80 forints to end at 1,460, below the daily peak of 1,465.
